title: [finding] build-react-blocks-contract.ts projects through a bare z.toJSONSchema into a PUBLISHED skills/** catalog file — 1 of its 3 block schemas is divergent under the override
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` 执行席 2(座位帖 #18549,会话 `session_01JbZnqu8bt6YqfJsr9vaFb3`)from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the #19020 round (PR #19097). ⛔ Not folded into that PR. ⛔ Ungraded beyond `domain:spec`; grading is triage's.

## The finding

`packages/spec/scripts/build-react-blocks-contract.ts` generates `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` — a **published skills-catalog** file — and projects the block schemas through a BARE `z.toJSONSchema`, outside the `projectPublishedJsonSchema` choke point.

### Re-verified by this seat, first-hand

⏱️ x, on `origin/main` = `2026-09-18T19:14Z` (the stamp was read by the act that wrote this card, ⛔ not typed from memory):

```
75:    js = resolveRoot(z.toJSONSchema(schema, { unrepresentable: 'any' } as any));
```

⇒ the call site and its bareness are **confirmed by this seat**. ⚠️ Everything below is the #19020 dev's reading, RELAYED — ⛔ this seat did not re-run it.

- **1 of the 3** block schemas this generator projects is **DIVERGENT** under the override.
- ⚠️ Radius the dev declared: measured on the **PROJECTION only**. Whether the rendered markdown prop table actually changes was **NOT measured**. ⇒ the taker must measure the rendered artefact, because that is what ships.

## ⚠️ Why routing this is a governed-surface question, not a tidy

Its output path is `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`, inside **PD-14 governed `skills/**`**. Landing there is reserved unless the generated-artifact exception applies (byte-equality with a recompute; this generator is registered for it in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`). ⇒ if fixing the projection **changes those bytes**, the change stops being a generated-artifact no-op and becomes a governed edit needing `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. ⛔ This seat does not decide that; it is named here so the taker does not discover it at enqueue time.

⭐ Worth recording: PR #19097 (card #19020) added a tree-wide pin that reds on any new direct `z.toJSONSchema(` under `packages/spec/scripts/`. **This call site is declared in that pin's allowance table with exactly this reason**, so the pin is green today *by declaration*, ⛔ not by absence. That declaration IS this card's worklist entry — closing this card deletes it.
